file_id: Kamal Patel vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 23 May, 2016

sentences.text: Kamal Patel vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 23 May, 2016

entities.text: Kamal Patel vs Indore Municipal Corporation
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri Prateek Maheshwari, learned counsel for applicant Kamal Patel s/o Shivnarayan Patel.
Ms. Mini Ravindran, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent / State, on advance notice.
Heard on IA No.4270/2016, an application for urgent hearing and IA No.4269/2016, an application for hearing during summer vacation.
On due consideration, both the interlocutory applications are allowed.
Heard on the question of admission.
Criminal revision is admitted for final hearing.
Ms. Mini Ravindran, learned Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of respondent / State, and therefore, no need to issue notice to them.
Record of the Courts below be called.
Also heard on IA No.4268/2016, first application under Section 389 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

On 22.07.2015, applicant Kamal s/o Shivnarayan Patel has been convicted under Section 7 (1) read with Section 16 (1)
(a) (1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.1,000/- along with default stipulation by the Special Judicial Magistrate (Indore Municipal Corporation), Indore in Criminal Case No.7154/2011; against which,
Criminal Appeal No.563/2015 has been dismissed by Additional Sessions Judge & Special Judge (Electricity Act), Indore on 12.05.2016.

entities.text: Special Judicial Magistrate (Indore Municipal Corporation), Indore
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge & Special Judge (Electricity Act), Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that during trial as well as during pendency of the criminal appeal, he was on bail and has not misused the liberty granted by the Courts below; at present he is in custody since 12.05.2016.

On due consideration of the aforesaid, the material evidence available on record and the short period of jail sentence awarded to the applicant by the learned courts below, I am inclined to allow the application.

Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merit of the case, IA No.4268/2016, first application for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to applicant Kamal Patel s/o Kamal Patel vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 23 May, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171011834/
1

entities.text: Kamal Patel vs Indore Municipal Corporation
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shivnarayan Patel is allowed and it is directed that the execution of jail sentence awarded to the applicant shall remain suspended, subject to his depositing the fine amount and upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand) with one local surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before this Court/Registry on 31th August, 2016 and on such other dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard.

(P.K. Jaiswal) Vacation Judge rcp Kamal Patel vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 23 May, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171011834/
